tools.name: find_leagues
tools.description: Find leagues (competitions) of a sport and their ids, optionally by name or country. Free.

tools.name: find_teams
tools.description: Find teams by name, with their ids, country, venue and leagues.

tools.name: get_league_facts
tools.description: What finished matches changed, newest first: the match story (comebacks, late winners, red cards), runs started or ended, table places and zones, each also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr). Use for 'what happened in this league today'. Facts only.

tools.name: get_live_matches
tools.description: Matches in play right now, with score and minute or period, and the TV channels showing them where known.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match: teams, score, status, events (goals, cards...), venue, referee; where known TV channels by country and, after the match, a highlights video link.

tools.name: get_match_briefing
tools.description: Ready briefing for one match (any sport): form, current streaks, home and away records, head-to-head, table position and gaps, stakes, schedule; for soccer also injuries, lineups and, after the match, the story (comeback, late winner, red cards). Each statement also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, f

tools.name: get_match_details
tools.description: Detail of one match: statistics or box score, lineups, injuries, or play-by-play.

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Matches (fixtures and results) by day or date range, optionally of one league. Without a date: today. Where known: TV channels by country (where to watch) and a highlights video link.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Player profile: position, nationality, birth date, height, team, career and photo link where known.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Team profile (country, founded, venue, leagues, logo link), optionally with its squad.

tools.name: get_team_briefing
tools.description: Ready briefing for one team (any sport; for tennis a player): form, streaks (overall, home, away), home and away record, table place and gaps, last and next match, injuries (soccer); each also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr). Facts only.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: Sports available, with whether each has upcoming matches. Free.
